realm.name: ebu-federation-writer
realm.description: Role that is required to save transformation definitions in the UI and call POST and PATCH endpoints of DSync and DNext microservices

realm.name: ebu-federation-reader
realm.description: Minimum role required to use the UI in a read-only manner and call GET endpoints of DSync and DNext microservices

realm.name: ebu-federation-admin
realm.description: Role that is required to start/stop dsync-engine and be able to publish message to the KV topic. Also have privilege to call DELETE endpoints of DSync and DNext microservices
